releases.name: v2.0.1: OpenCode V2 support
releases.body:
Same package now works on both OpenCode V1 and V2.

- V2: plugins: [opencode-parser]
- V1: plugin: [opencode-parser] (needs OpenCode 1.18.29+)
- Deps bundled, so plain install just works
- Save-to-markdown now truly unlimited and lands next to the original file

Thanks to @okhiroyuki for the V2 migration.

### Added
- New \save\ option to export full parsed output as .md file alongside the original
- New \outputPath\ option for custom markdown export paths
- Auto-save with default filename when \save: true\ is set
- CLI install instructions in README

### Fixed
- Added \llowImportingTsExtensions\ to tsconfig.json
Initial release. Supports PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, images (OCR), EPUB, HTML, XML, Markdown, IPYNB, ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, GZip, JSON, YAML, TOML, INI, and plain text.
